Every day, over 70,000 cubic meters of water are provided to the Gaza Strip through multiple water lines and desalination facilities, exceeding the benchmark for a population’s water needs. COGAT continuously works with its international partners to coordinate new projects and infrastructure maintenance to enhance the local water lines, plants and wells, like this project by @UNICEF, to improve WASH conditions in Gaza. In addition to the improvement of local water sources, water tankers and other essential WASH supplies such as chlorine tabs are brought into Gaza through COGAT’s coordination, supplying water where needed according to our local partners and sources on the ground. COGAT remains committed to facilitating projects that improve humanitarian conditions and ensuring water reaches Gazan civilians, while preventing Hamas from exploiting the water infrastructure for its own interests, as has been proven in the past.
